name.title: Accessory Name
name.description: Name shown in Apple Home for this accessory

host.title: Envoy Address
host.description: IP address or hostname of your Enphase Envoy or IQ Gateway on the local network

protocol.title: Connection Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the Envoy

allowInsecureTLS.title: Allow Self Signed HTTPS Certificate
allowInsecureTLS.description: Enable this if your Envoy uses a self signed HTTPS certificate (common). If disabled and the Envoy uses a self signed certificate, requests may fail

mode.title: Production Endpoint
mode.description: Select the Envoy endpoint used to read current production

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the Envoy is queried for updates

onThresholdW.title: Production ON Threshold (W)
onThresholdW.description: If production is equal or above this value, the Production Active sensor becomes active

offThresholdW.title: Production OFF Threshold (W)
offThresholdW.description: If production is equal or below this value, the Production Active sensor becomes inactive

token.title: Manual Authentication Token
token.description: Optional. Paste the bearer token value only (without the word Bearer). If Auto JWT Token Refresh is enabled, this manual token is not used

autoJwt.title: Auto JWT Token Refresh
autoJwt.description: Automatically logs in and fetches a fresh JWT when needed. When enabled you must provide Entrez Username, Entrez Password, and Envoy Serial Number

entrezUsername.title: Entrez Username
entrezUsername.description: Your Enphase account email used for Enlighten and Entrez login. Required when Auto JWT Token Refresh is enabled

entrezPassword.title: Entrez Password
entrezPassword.description: Your Enphase account password. Required when Auto JWT Token Refresh is enabled

envoySerial.title: Envoy Serial Number
envoySerial.description: Serial number of your Envoy or IQ Gateway. Required when Auto JWT Token Refresh is enabled

enableInverterLeakSensor.title: Enable Inverter Failure Monitoring
enableInverterLeakSensor.description: When enabled, an Inverter Alert Leak Sensor is created in HomeKit. It triggers when the number of online inverters is lower than expected

expectedInverters.title: Expected Number of Inverters
expectedInverters.description: Set to 0 to learn automatically from the first successful inverter reading. Set a fixed number if you want strict monitoring

inverterDebug.title: Inverter Debug Logging
inverterDebug.description: Logs which inverter source is used and the online versus expected counts

debugLogging.title: Production Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Logs production watts on every poll at debug level

debugBurstCount.title: Temporary Debug Burst Count
debugBurstCount.description: Logs the next N polling cycles at info level, then stops automatically. Useful for short diagnostics
